description: Rede de Drenagem is a series of datasets listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Mapa da rede de drenagem do Estado de São Paulo delimitada a partir do Modelo Digital de Elevação (MDE) do ano de 2013. ATENÇÃO: A rede de drenagem consiste em um conjunto de canais conectados entre si, os quais drenam a água superficial tanto PLUVIAL quanto FLUVIAL, dessa forma, não representa apenas a hidrografia. Coverage: Brasil. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. Its tags are rede; drenagem; água; agua; pluvial; fluvial; pluviais; fluviais; redes; drenagens, Hidrografia e Hidrologia. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
